content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in McKinney

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires a secondary degree and project management education—not work experience. If you hold a high school diploma or higher qualification, you meet the education requirement. This makes CAPM ideal for career changers and early-stage professionals entering McKinney's aerospace, defense, insurance, and logistics sectors.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Hours of Instruction
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot camp. Our intensive format compresses the required contact hours into a focused, interactive program delivered nationwide. You'll study PMBOK fundamentals, processes, and exam strategy with active certified practitioners guiding every session from start to finish.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing coursework, create your PMI account and submit your CAPM application directly to the Project Management Institute. You'll provide proof of your secondary degree and training completion. Once approved, you'll receive authorization to schedule your exam and pay the associated fee.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy provides targeted exam-preparation resources to reinforce key concepts and test-taking strategies. When you're ready, schedule your computer-based CAPM exam through PMI's testing partner. The exam validates your understanding of project management fundamentals across all domains.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: CAPM holds for three years. To renew, earn professional development units (PDUs) through continuing education, project work, or volunteer service aligned with PMI standards. Staying current keeps your credential active and demonstrates your commitment to professional growth in project management.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.

fq_items.question: Is this training delivered online?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Our CAPM training is fully live-virtual — no travel required. {city} students attend via video conference from wherever they are.
